title: DSH is not running: the port judgement says unknown, not pass
titleZh: DSH 没在跑:端口判定报 unknown,不报 pass
why: defensive-spec section 7 case 11. With no listener on the DSH port the collector cannot measure the bind, so 'loopback only' is unproven. Reporting pass here would be the exact 'probe missing = pass' failure the spec forbids.
inject: the DSH listening row removed from both netstat snapshots (only the 443 row survives)
